summary: OSpec 1.8.23 improves release checkout generation, metadata synchronization, and publication verification so the public repository and npm package stay aligned with the supported release surface.
new: Added an export-time validation pass for release-facing text assets.
improved: Release checkout synchronization now refreshes source-managed release metadata while preserving target-only release files.
Tightened release inventory selection to the supported documentation, runtime assets, and publishing tools.
fixed: Fixed release checkout drift caused by overly broad inventory selection.
Fixed stale matching release metadata surviving a synchronization pass.
Added regression coverage for release inventory and publication content consistency.
docs: Updated the maintainer release workflow for deterministic checkout synchronization.
